summary: P4 wave 1 (Core, producer-first) — extend the existing Core drift test RecipeAuthoringSpecDrift.test.ts (today only covers A.6 #4 markdown plus field snapshot and #6 constant snapshots) into the full guidance-equals-gate drift suite per design sections A.6 and B-P4.1, every assertion reading the one gateRules table so guidance and gate stay two projections of a single source. ADD these drift assertions. drift#1 allowlist parity: getImperativeVerbAllowlist positive byte-equals the stage-1 predicate Set AND the rendered doClause guidance string lists exactly those verbs (this catches the real drift where the guidance only said verb-led while the gate enforces a closed 45-verb set). drift#2 marker parity: the rendered guidance states the both-markers and at-least-4-non-space-chars-after-the-marker rule AND a property assertion feeds the guidance own worked-example markdown through validateAgainst stage 1 and asserts zero violations. drift#3 evidence-floor parity: getEvidenceFloorPolicy ruleFiles 3 factFiles 1 plus the scope-escape regex equals the evidence floor numbers and regex AND the rendered guidance includes the scope narrow or file-local escape the gate honors. drift#7 enforcement-matrix parity: assert the checked-in fixture recipe-gate-enforcement-matrix.json still lists exactly the reject codes found by grepping the three gate files so the layered-not-duplicated matrix can never silently reopen. Decision D-A confidence drift assertion: the rendered guidance confidence wording is recommended at least 0.85 not enforced AND gate-rules exposes no confidence floor predicate so guidance can never re-inflate a fake hard floor. KEEP drift#5 example self-consistency (already standing in RecipeAuthoringSpecExamplesGatePassing.test.ts) and drift#6 no-relaxation snapshot (already present) referenced as the standing tripwires. Also ADD the section 12.5 two-paths-tie parity tripwire as a Core test: for a small fixture candidate corpus, under a FIXED profile and FIXED ports, validateAgainst with path host-cold-start must produce byte-identical violation arrays to validateAgainst with path in-process, proving the path label itself does not change the verdict and the two real submission paths face the same bar at the Core API. Non-regression P4.2: npm run check on Node 22 green except the three pre-existing out-of-scope lint:naming files (carve-out, do not touch), full Core suite green, gates byte-identical meaning no gate-rules or UnifiedValidator or recipe-content-quality-gate or recipe-evidence-gate file is touched. Hard discipline: gates not relaxed (this is additive tests plus possibly a tiny guidance wording fix only if a drift assertion legitimately catches a guidance string that does not yet list the verbs or escape, never a gate change), additive tests, develop on main only, commit local do not push or tag or bump. Acceptance reference is the controller P0 oracle at evidence/p0-gate-truth-matrix-2026-06-30.md (verb count 45 positive 12 negative, marker threshold 4, no confidence floor) plus design sections A.6 and B-P4. If any drift assertion reveals a real guidance-versus-gate mismatch, FIX THE GUIDANCE to match the gate, never relax the gate.
